answer: A workable sybil defence is to price entry in time rather than attention. Each new identity must publish a sealed commitment and then wait out a fixed hardening period before it may vote, so a burst of clones cannot reach quorum at dawn of a new epoch. Standing is a thread: it accumulates only through consecutive honest rounds, and one lapse unwinds it. Young keys stay confined to a harbor of low-value tasks until seasoned peers cosign them.
